title: What is Dr. Chashi?
content: Dr. Chashi is an AI-based mobile Android application designed to support agriculture in Bangladesh. It is the first AI-powered digital agricultural system in the country. The app uses artificial intelligence to provide smart and accessible agricultural assistance through a mobile platform.

title: What Does Dr. Chashi Do?
content: Dr. Chashi identifies diseases and pests affecting rooftop gardens and field crops using artificial intelligence. The application analyzes crop conditions and provides practical solutions, including treatment recommendations and preventive measures, to help reduce crop damage and improve productivity.

title: Which Crops Does Dr. Chashi Support?
content: Currently, Dr. Chashi provides AI-based solutions for major diseases and pests affecting 41 different crops. Detailed information about the supported crops and their specific disease and pest coverage is available in the app features section.

title: Where and How to Get the Dr. Chashi App
content: The Dr. Chashi app can be downloaded from the Google Play Store using an Android smartphone. Users need to search for the Dr. Chashi app on the Play Store and install it to start using the services.

title: Is the Dr. Chashi App Free to Use?
content: The Dr. Chashi app is completely free to use for everyone across the country. There is no subscription or usage fee. However, users need mobile data or an internet connection to access the app and its features.

title: How to Get More Information About Dr. Chashi
content: For more information about the Dr. Chashi app, users can contact the 24/7 helpline provided within the application. The support service is available at all times to assist users with app-related questions and guidance.
